# Camp Ashgrove

A waystation on the old caravan road, run by a retired quartermaster who still keeps its books to the day.

## Personnel

- Quartermaster Beren Voss keeps the ledgers
- Two hired scouts watch the northern approach
- A cook who trades gossip more freely than meals

## Supplies

| Item | Quantity |
| Dried ration | 40 |
| Lamp oil | 12 |

Beren Voss trusts the scouts with the gate key but never with the ledgers.
